note: REFUTED. 19 of 28 have runnable material in their own spike; 7 more name no spike at all in the row (a documentation gap, not an absence); only 2 are genuinely bare.

controls.name: partition-discriminates
controls.must_fire_because: if every unannotated claim fell in one bucket the survey would say nothing about why they are unannotated
controls.can_fail_because: a survey returning all-NONE would SUPPORT the falsifier instead of refuting it; it returned 4 kinds
controls.null_must_contain: more than one kind across the 28

controls.name: matcher-resolves-spike-names
controls.must_fire_because: the first matcher scored 11 as NONE purely because M1.7d did not glob to M1_7_transport -- absence of a match is not absence of a reproducer
controls.can_fail_because: if the fallback changed nothing, NONE would still be 11 and the partition would be an artifact of the regex
controls.null_must_contain: prefix fallback must move claims out of NONE

controls.name: s34-hash-discriminates
controls.must_fire_because: identical hashes prove bit-exactness only if the hash can differ at all
controls.can_fail_because: s34_check.py reports CONTROL DEAD and fails if every hash in the output is the same value
controls.null_must_contain: a second hash over a different buffer must not equal the kernel hash

falsifier: the 28 unannotated A-grade claims are unannotated because no runnable reproducer exists for them
